description: IRA owner born in 1959: start age 73, first required year 2032; nothing required in 2026.
worked:
IRA owner born 1959-11-30; age attained on the 2026 birthday = 2026 - 1959 = 67. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Born 1959 fits both clauses of 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as written (attains 73 before January 1, 2033, and 74 after December 31, 2032); the federal file records age 73, reading clause (I)'s 1951-1959 range as controlling.
Required beginning age (IRC 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as amended by SECURE 2.0): born 1959 -> age 73; first distribution year = 1959 + 73 = 2032.
2026 is before 2032 (age 67 is under 73): no required minimum distribution for 2026; required amount 0.
